Metadata.title: Pawth | A Small Daily Journaling App
Metadata.description: A daily journaling app for recording one entry a day and looking back through your calendar and timeline.

Hero.label: About Pawth
Hero.title: Pawth
Hero.lead: A daily journal for leaving one small footprint each day
Hero.description: Record your day, then look back on your journey through the calendar and timeline.

Screens.label: App Screens
Screens.title: What You Can Do with Pawth
Screens.description: Record each day and look back on the days you've accumulated in different ways.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: Each day you write an entry leaves a footprint on the calendar, making it easy to revisit what you recorded that day.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.description: Browse your past entries chronologically and scroll through the record you've built over time.

settings.title: Customize
settings.description: Choose the icon displayed on your calendar and change the visibility of your journal.

Usability.label: Usability
Usability.title: Simple and Easy to Use
Usability.description: Because Pawth is designed for everyday use, it keeps features focused and interactions simple and intuitive.

record.title: Simple UI
record.description: Pawth focuses on the features you need, with a clean interface designed to stay easy to navigate.

calendar.title: Swipe Support
calendar.description: On smartphones, swipe gestures make it natural to move between screens and journal entries.

timeline.title: Responsive Design
timeline.description: Pawth adapts to desktops, tablets, and smartphones for a comfortable experience across screen sizes.

ThemeColors.label: Theme Colors
ThemeColors.title: Make It Feel Like Yours
ThemeColors.description: Choose between light, dark, and system themes to match your environment and preference.
ThemeColors.imageAlt: Pawth calendar displayed in dark theme
